bull.t: Rapid revenue growth and raised outlook
bull.b: Strong reported growth, a 20-quarter beat-and-raise streak, and higher full-year guidance indicate sustained customer demand and effective execution. Continued expansion at this scale can support operating leverage, increase strategic investment capacity, and strengthen Zeta’s competitive position.

bull.t: Robust free cash flow and improving profitability
bull.b: Rapidly growing free cash flow provides internally generated funding for product development, partnerships, M&A, and balance-sheet flexibility. The improvement alongside higher adjusted EBITDA and positive quarterly GAAP income suggests Zeta is converting expanding scale into stronger financial capacity.

bull.t: Proprietary data and AI ecosystem advantage
bull.b: A large proprietary data asset, broader AI adoption, and higher retention among AI users can deepen customer dependence on Zeta’s platform. Strategic integrations with major technology partners also expand product utility and support durable cross-sell across marketing use cases.

bear.b: Although losses have narrowed and one quarter produced positive GAAP income, profitability is not yet consistently established. Thin operating margins leave earnings sensitive to cost execution, making it harder to absorb setbacks or reliably fund growth from bottom-line profits.

bear.t: Channel mix is pressuring gross margin
bear.b: Greater exposure to lower-margin social-channel activity can dilute the economics of otherwise strong revenue growth. If this mix persists, it may constrain gross-margin expansion, reduce operating leverage, and require continued execution to protect cash generation.

bear.t: Headline growth includes meaningful M&A contribution
bear.b: The gap between reported and organic growth shows that acquisitions contribute materially to the current expansion rate. Sustaining results therefore depends partly on integrating acquired operations and continuing to generate strong underlying demand, adding execution complexity.
